title: Fourier weight outside a family
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and a family $\mathcal{F}$ of subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the Fourier weight outside $\mathcal{F}$ is the sum of the Fourier weights of $f$ over all subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ that do not belong to $\mathcal{F}$.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\mathbb{R}$
